title: Microsoft Edge: switch between Workspaces inside one window
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, release versions and dates, Group Policy paths and registry settings are supported. One minor clarification should acknowledge that Microsoft Support still describes the switching updates as coming soon for some users, whereas the Stable release notes list them as available.

claims.where: What's changing; summary; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Users can now switch Workspaces in their current browser window instead of opening a separate window for each Workspace.
